free_text: Despite a PSA of 9.1 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 4 finding, the decision is no biopsy because the patient is 79 years old with no prior prostate cancer history (csPCa 0.0) and a normal Digital Rectal Exam. The combination of age and stable physical findings supports deferring invasive testing in favor of active surveillance. Therefore, a prostate biopsy is not recommended at this time.
